title: Splatter, Scribble and Swirl
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 27 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Marks thrown, dripped, scribbled and spun. The twenty-seven works in this room are the Abstract series at its loosest: splashes on a bare ground, crowds of short strokes, swirls that turn in a circle, lines that sweep across the square and leave. The room ends on the collection piece, number zero zero zero zero.

Three kinds of gesture hang here. The splash, which hits the ground and spreads. The scribble, which covers it. And the swirl, which turns the whole square into one motion, like a ball of yarn or a storm seen from above.
Look for the one face. Number thirty-eight is a skull drawn in loose loops over soft color, and it is the only face in the Abstract series. It hangs among the swirls because the loops are the same.

chapters.title: Splashes on a Field
chapters.opening: Numbers five to twenty. Dots and splashes on dark or grey grounds, with lines scratched through them.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #05
works.text: Dots of yellow, pink and cyan scattered over a dark marbled field, with white brush strokes dragged across the middle and bursts of pale yellow like fireworks. The field itself is streaked in green, blue and red, and the dots sit on top of it in drifts. It is the first gesture work by number, and it already has all three kinds: the splash, the scribble in the field, and the sweep of the white strokes.
works.caption: Dots of yellow, pink and cyan scattered over a dark marbled field, white strokes dragged across the middle.
works.reading: The dots are round and opaque, mostly black with colored centers, and they cluster at the upper right. The white strokes are two long diagonals with soft edges. The bursts are pale yellow rays at the upper left and lower right.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #08
works.text: Red hatching in bunches over grey and green, with cyan and yellow line looping across it, and white hatching at the left.
works.caption: Red hatching in bunches over grey and green, cyan and yellow line looping across it.
works.reading: The hatching is drawn in short parallel strokes, red and magenta, in patches that run diagonally. The cyan and yellow lines are thin and continuous, drawn in loops over the whole. A white patch at the upper left is the lightest area.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #17
works.text: Bright splashes of orange, blue, magenta and green on grey, with vertical dark streaks behind them and white bursts at the center.
works.caption: Bright splashes of orange, blue, magenta and green on grey, vertical dark streaks behind them.
works.reading: The splashes are thick and opaque, laid in bunches with ragged edges. The dark streaks behind run vertically in olive and black. The white bursts at the center are drawn in short radiating strokes.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #18
works.text: A teal ground with pink and yellow lines scribbled across it, maroon splashes at the corners, and a white patch at the lower left.
works.caption: Pink and yellow lines scribbled over teal, maroon splashes at two corners, white at the lower left.
works.reading: The lines are thin and run in long loops from edge to edge. The maroon splashes are soft, at the upper right and lower left. A black line crosses the upper half, and a grid of fine white lines sits at the lower right.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #19
works.text: A dark brown ground with a tangle of white line at the center, like a figure or a plant, and splashes of pink, yellow and red thrown around it. The white tangle is drawn in loops that climb from the bottom to the top. The splashes are soft and bright. It is the darkest ground in the room, and the one where the splash reads most like something thrown.
works.caption: A tangle of white line climbs a dark brown ground, splashes of pink, yellow and red thrown around it.
works.reading: The white tangle is drawn in thin continuous loops with yellow inside it. The pink splashes are at the lower left and center right; the red at the upper right. Grey discs float in the dark behind everything.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #20
works.text: Pink and cyan scratches over a soft blue and pink ground, with yellow strokes and black dashes, and a small figure at the lower right.
works.caption: Pink and cyan scratches over soft blue and pink, yellow strokes and black dashes, a small figure below.
works.reading: The scratches are short and layered, in cyan, white and pink. The yellow strokes run diagonally at the right. The small figure at the lower right is a few strokes of pink and black, bent over. A diagonal black line crosses the center.

chapters.title: Crowds of Strokes
chapters.opening: Numbers twenty-one to twenty-seven. The square fills with short strokes until it is a crowd.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #21
works.text: A dense crowd of short strokes in pink, teal, yellow and red, crossing in every direction, with rows of dots through them.
works.caption: A dense crowd of short strokes in pink, teal, yellow and red crossing in every direction.
works.reading: The strokes are laid in diagonal rows that cross, with dots strung between them like beads. The color is strongest at the upper left and lower right. A few white dashes sit at the top.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #22
works.text: Dark ground with colored bars crossing it: yellow and purple vertical, white and grey diagonal, and tangles of fine line between them.
works.caption: Dark ground with yellow and purple vertical bars crossed by white and grey diagonals, fine line between.
works.reading: The yellow bars are brushy and bright, three of them across the upper half. The purple ones are at the right. The white diagonals cross from the upper left. Cyan and green scribble fills the lower left.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #23
works.caption: Sweeping yellow and black lines on mauve, a dark knot at the center, scribble along the bottom.
works.reading: The yellow lines are long thin diagonals. The black ones are thicker and curve. The knot at the center is a dense scribble of black with green and red. The lower edge is a band of fine black loops.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #24
works.text: A brown ground filled edge to edge with short bars of color: red, yellow, cyan, pink, green and white, laid in a loose grid so that they read as a crowd of small flags. Black bars run among them. It is the brightest surface in the series and the most even, with no center and no empty corner.
works.caption: A brown ground filled with short bars of red, yellow, cyan and green in a loose grid.
works.reading: The bars are short, thick strokes, mostly vertical and horizontal, each a single color. The black bars are longer and run vertically. Thin pale lines cross the whole at an angle. The grid is loose enough that the brown ground shows between every bar.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #27
works.text: A textured mass of mauve, green, orange and yellow, drawn in fine scribble, with a block of pink at the lower left and black marks at the center.
works.caption: A textured mass of mauve, green, orange and yellow in fine scribble, pink at the lower left.
works.reading: The scribble is tight and dense, so the colors blend at a distance. The black marks at the center are small loops. A scratched patch of white and yellow sits at the right of center.

chapters.title: Swirls and a Skull
chapters.opening: Numbers thirty-five to forty. Strokes that turn in a circle, and in the middle of them the one face in the series.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #35
works.text: A grey haze with white and yellow strokes laid over it, a chain of dots running down the center, and black marks at the corners.
works.caption: White and yellow strokes over a grey haze, a chain of dots down the center.
works.reading: The haze is soft grey and pink with green at the center. The white strokes are thick and curved, at the lower left and right. The yellow ones are at the top corners. The dots run in a vertical chain through the middle.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #36
works.text: Dense colored scribble in pink, yellow, green and blue, with spirals drawn in it and black loops over everything.
works.caption: Dense colored scribble in pink, yellow, green and blue, spirals drawn in it, black loops over everything.
works.reading: The spirals are green and black, two or three of them at the right. The black loops are drawn over the color in thick continuous line. White dashes float at the top. The whole square is covered.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #37
works.text: A swirl on blue: thick black and white strokes turn in a circle around a center of red and gold, with yellow and purple strokes caught in the turn. The black strokes are the longest marks in the series, curving from the top to the bottom edge. The whole picture moves in one direction, like water going down a drain.
works.caption: Thick black and white strokes turn in a circle on blue around a center of red and gold.
works.reading: The black strokes are drawn in long arcs, with white dashes along them like reflections. The center is a knot of red, gold and orange strokes. The blue ground shows at the corners and through the gaps. A white patch at the lower center is the brightest point.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #38
works.text: A skull drawn in loose black loops over soft patches of red, green, blue and pink on white: two red eyes, a long nose, a row of teeth along the bottom. Thin black lines frame it. It is the only face in the Abstract series, and it hangs here because the loops that draw it are the loops of the swirls around it.
works.caption: A skull drawn in loose black loops over soft patches of red, green and blue on white, two red eyes.
works.reading: The loops are drawn without lifting, and they double back on themselves at the eyes and the jaw. The red eyes are two soft blocks. The teeth are a row of loops along the lower edge. The soft color behind is laid in blocks and bars, with a pink stroke across the brow.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #40
works.text: A brown mass hangs over a fire of red and orange strokes on grey, like smoke rising from flame.
works.caption: A brown cloud of strokes hangs over red and orange flames on grey.
works.reading: The brown is drawn in short strokes that pile up into a cloud at the upper center. The fire is a row of red, orange and yellow strokes at the bottom with blue between them. The grey ground is soft and pale.

chapters.title: Grass, Drips and the Collection Piece
chapters.opening: Numbers forty-one to fifty, then the work titled pos, and the collection piece to end the wing.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #41
works.text: A field of grass-like strokes in blue, grey, white and yellow-green, standing up from the lower edge and leaning to the right, on white. The strokes are thin and close, like reeds. Blue is strongest at the left, green at the bottom. It is the one work in the room drawn entirely in vertical strokes, and the one that most looks like a place.
works.caption: Grass-like strokes in blue, grey and yellow-green stand up from the lower edge on white.
works.reading: The strokes overlap in layers, with grey and white over blue and green under them. The tops of the strokes fray into the white at the upper third. A few yellow-green strokes at the lower corners are the brightest marks.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #42
works.text: On maroon, two crossed bars of gold and black at the center like a kite, with splashes of pink, teal and yellow around them.
works.caption: Two crossed bars of gold and black on maroon like a kite, splashes of pink around them.
works.reading: The bars are drawn in fine black lines over gold, crossing at a right angle. The splashes are thick strokes in bunches. White patches sit at the upper center and left. The maroon ground is flat.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #43
works.text: On teal, splatter and drips in yellow, white, black and purple, with thin orange lines crossing the square.
works.caption: On teal, splatter and drips in yellow, white, black and purple, thin orange lines crossing.
works.reading: The yellow strokes are short and bright, in bunches at the upper left and right. The white is thrown in splatters at the lower left. The black runs in vertical drips at the center. The orange lines are long thin arcs.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #44
works.text: Round dark blots on ochre, six of them, each drawn in circling strokes of teal and black like a thumbprint.
works.caption: Six round dark blots on ochre, each drawn in circling strokes of teal and black like a thumbprint.
works.reading: The blots are at different sizes and placed loosely in two rows. The strokes inside each one circle a dark center. The ochre ground is streaked with the same circling strokes in paler color. A black loop at the lower right is a seventh, open.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #45
works.caption: On white, dense black splatter with lines of red, cyan, yellow and green thrown across it.
works.reading: The splatter is black with a mauve wash behind it, densest at the center. The colored lines are long and straight, crossing at angles. Small bursts of green and magenta sit at the corners.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #46
works.text: A swirl of yellow, black and grey-blue on grey, turning in a loose circle like a ball of yarn, with black dots caught in it. The strokes are short and curved, and they follow the turn. The grey ground shows all around. It is the lightest of the swirls, and the one with the clearest circle.
works.caption: A swirl of yellow, black and grey-blue strokes on grey, turning like a ball of yarn.
works.reading: The yellow strokes are brightest at the right and the top. The black dots are scattered through the turn. The blue is soft and sits behind the other strokes. The ground is a flat warm grey.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #47
works.text: Bright swirling strokes in magenta, yellow, cyan and black on grey, with a magenta loop at the center and white at the edges.
works.caption: Bright swirling strokes in magenta, yellow, cyan and black on grey, a magenta loop at the center.
works.reading: The strokes are thick and layered, cyan over yellow over black. The magenta loop is drawn in one line around the center. Red and orange strokes hang at the lower right. The grey ground shows at the top corners.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #48
works.text: A soft pink and lilac haze with a single thin dark line drawn through it in a wandering path, down the right and across the bottom.
works.caption: A soft pink and lilac haze with a single thin dark line wandering down the right and across the bottom.
works.reading: The haze is made of small strokes in pink, lilac, blue and green, blended at a distance. The line is thin, dark red, and drawn in one path with a few sharp turns. Nothing else is drawn.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #50
works.text: On yellow and white, a splash of black and color at the center dripping downward, with pink, green and purple caught in it.
works.caption: A splash of black and color at the center of a yellow and white page, dripping down.
works.reading: The yellow is laid in soft strokes at the upper left and right, and the center is white. The splash is black with pink, green, purple and blue strokes inside it, and it runs in drips to the lower center. Fine speckle surrounds it.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #pos
works.text: A round mass of red, orange, teal and brown strokes on grey, drawn in circling layers like a burning ball, with drips running down from its lower edge. The strokes turn around a center and pile up until the mass is almost solid. The grey ground is scratched with grey lines. Its title is pos, the one Abstract work without a number.
works.caption: A round mass of red, orange and teal strokes on grey like a burning ball, dripping below.
works.reading: The circling strokes are short and thick, red and orange on the outside, teal and brown inside. The drips are thin vertical lines in orange, teal and black, running to the bottom edge. Red flares stand up from the top of the mass.

works.title: nnxyz abstract #0000
works.text: The collection piece, an edition of one. Yellow-green and magenta patches on a pale ground, black splatter thrown over them, and a tangle of thin orange, cyan and black lines drawn through the lower half, with a block of black scribble at the bottom. Loops, splashes and lines together. Where the first splash in this room threw dots on a dark field, this one throws its marks over a pale page and draws through them.
works.caption: Yellow-green and magenta patches with black splatter thrown over them and a tangle of thin lines below.
works.reading: The yellow-green is a broad horizontal patch across the middle. The magenta is at the upper left and right. The black splatter is thrown in bursts at the top. The thin lines in the lower half are drawn in loops and ladders, orange, cyan and black, over black scribble.

closing: Look again at the first splash, dots on a dark field, and then at the collection piece, where splatter, patches and lines are all on one page. The room's three gestures end up together. The swirls between them are the series turning in place.
